sources.title: Renting AI from foreign providers is a national security risk, warns Cohere CEO
sources.quote_checked: centralized dependence on a single entity is a structural risk | This sentiment of renting AI from someone rather than owning it is a national security risk | You need to fully control it. | Don't build a system with a single point of failure.

sources.title: The Canadian founder telling CEOs to rethink AI resilience
sources.quote_checked: We can't see in. We can't switch it off. We can't intervene in any way. | We believe you can't rent your sovereignty from someone. You need to own it.

sources.title: Resilience
sources.quote_checked: Strategic resilience is not free, but the cost of fragility is immense. | In pursuit of maximal efficiency, we have been left with fragility. | Sovereignty should not mean isolationism or decoupling.
